title_en: Area Recognition Criteria for Common Curriculum (General Education) Courses
summary: Following the 2025 reorganisation of the general education curriculum, this notice explains how common curriculum (general education) courses are counted towards required areas, such as the World of Scholarship (학문의 세계) area. Whether a course counts towards an area is decided by the common curriculum completion requirements of the student's year of admission. No deadline or required action is stated; students should check their own year's requirements and the two attached documents.
applies_to: Students who take common curriculum (general education) courses and need them recognised towards area requirements. The notice states no limit by program, year of admission, semester or nationality. It is informational and sets out no mandatory action.
conditions: Whether a course counts towards an area is decided by the common curriculum completion requirements of the student's year of admission.
If you complete a course created after your year of admission, and that course's area exists in your admission year's requirements, it counts as credits for that area.

If you complete a course created after your year of admission, and that course's area does not exist in your admission year's requirements, it does not count towards the required area credits. It counts only towards your total common curriculum (general education) credits.

If a new course is designated as equivalent to, or a replacement for, an existing course, taking the new course counts as credits for the area the existing course belonged to before the reorganisation.
steps: Check the common curriculum completion requirements for your year of admission.

Read Attachment 1 (Guide to Area Recognition Criteria for Common Curriculum Courses) and Attachment 2 (2024–2026 Common Curriculum Areas and Courses Comparison Table), which are attached to the original notice. Their content was not read for this translation.

Before you register for a course created after your year of admission, check whether it is designated as an equivalent or replacement course. Also check whether its area exists in your admission year's requirements.
For questions, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Area Recognition Criteria for Common Curriculum Courses (World of Scholarship [학문의 세계] Area, etc.)

Following the reorganisation of the general education curriculum in the 2025 academic year, the criteria for recognising the areas of common curriculum courses are set out below.

1. Whether a course is recognised towards an area is determined according to the common curriculum completion requirements of the student's year of admission.

2. Where a student has completed a course that was newly created after the student's year of admission:
   a. If the area exists in the completion requirements of the student's year of admission, the course is recognised as credits completed for that area.
   b. If the area does not exist in the completion requirements of the student's year of admission, the course is not included in the required area completion. It is recognised only as credits towards the total common curriculum (general education) credits.
   ※ Where a course is designated as an equivalent or replacement course, taking the new course is recognised as credits for the pre-reorganisation area of the existing course to which it is designated as equivalent or replacement.
